title: Postponement of Additional MOVE HODLer Airdrops (2025-05-07)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, We had  first announced in December 2024  that Binance was scheduled to launch an additional HODLer Airdrops for Movement (MOVE) (5% of total supply) approximately six months after its initial spot listing. Due to ongoing developments related to the Movement project, we have decided to postpone the MOVE HODLer Airdrops until further clarity is provided by the project regarding the situation. In the meantime, MOVE tokens collected for the additional HODLer Airdrops will be held in the following public wallet for the community’s visibility and transparency (click  here  to view). Protecting our users and maintaining transparency remain our top priorities. We will continue to closely monitor developments and provide updates when appropriate. Thank you for your understanding and support. Binance Team 2025-05-07
